customers_say: Customers appreciate Aquaguard's product quality, installation, and water quality, while sentiments on value for money and reliability are mixed. Their best-selling purifiers feature multi-stage purification technologies like RO+UV+UF+MC, water-saving capabilities up to 60%, and extended filter life with free service plans.
